title: Canva client secret in a parameter, field or Basic envelope
summary: A synthetic client secret after client_secret in a form body, a JSON body and a shell assignment, a value with no cnvca prefix, and the encoded Basic credential of a client id and secret in an Authorization header.
rationale: Canva documents client_secret as a token-request parameter whose value begins with cnvca and lists the secret as something the app owner generates and saves. The prefix is the only format fact: no separator, body length or alphabet is stated, so the context carries the case and no bare-prefix rule is implied. In a form body the extent stops at the next delimiter. In an Authorization Basic envelope the secret exists only inside the encoded credential, so the extent is the whole encoded token, not a decoded secret-only span.

expectation.rationale: Flagged under project policy: the value of a client_secret parameter or field, and the encoded credential after the Basic scheme, are treated as credentials. Canva documents the parameter, the cnvca prefix and the generated secret (carrier existence only); that the Basic envelope is Base64 of client id and secret joined by a colon is read from the same documentation, but the envelope extent, value admission and generic attribution are the project's decisions. These layouts may already be covered by generic contextual rules; the expectation is neutral about which rule covers them.

sources.supports: client_secret string Optional Your app's client secret, for authenticating the request. Begins with cnvca .

notes: Project-authored by the Redact Secret project, which maintains this repository; not independent evidence. Draft; not yet reviewed.
